record.bible_text: In the third<WH07969> year<WH08141> of the reign<WH04438> of Jehoiakim<WH03079> king<WH04428> of Judah<WH03063> came<WH0935><WTH8804> Nebuchadnezzar<WH05019> king<WH04428> of Babylon<WH0894> unto Jerusalem<WH03389>, and besieged<WH06696><WTH8799> it.

Children<WH03206> in whom <FI>was<Fi> no blemish<WH03971><WTH8675><WH03971>, but well<WH02896> favoured<WH04758>, and skilful<WH07919><WTH8688> in all wisdom<WH02451>, and cunning<WH03045><WTH8802> in knowledge<WH01847>, and understanding<WH0995><WTH8688> science<WH04093>, and such as <FI>had<Fi> ability<WH03581> in them to stand<WH05975><WTH8800> in the king's<WH04428> palace<WH01964>, and whom they might teach<WH03925><WTH8763> the learning<WH05612> and the tongue<WH03956> of the Chaldeans<WH03778>.

And the king<WH04428> appointed<WH04487><WTH8762> them a daily<WH03117><WH03117> provision<WH01697> of the king's<WH04428> meat<WH06598>, and of the wine<WH03196> which he drank<WH04960>: so nourishing<WH01431><WTH8763> them three<WH07969> years<WH08141>, that at the end<WH07117> thereof they might stand<WH05975><WTH8799> before<WH06440> the king<WH04428>. <RF>the wine...: Heb. the wine of his drink<Rf>
Now among these were of the children<WH01121> of Judah<WH03063>, Daniel<WH01840>, Hananiah<WH02608>, Mishael<WH04332>, and Azariah<WH05838>:

Unto whom the prince<WH08269> of the eunuchs<WH05631> gave<WH07760><WTH8799> names<WH08034>: for he gave<WH07760><WTH8799> unto Daniel<WH01840> <FI>the name<Fi> of Belteshazzar<WH01095>; and to Hananiah<WH02608>, of Shadrach<WH07714>; and to Mishael<WH04332>, of Meshach<WH04335>; and to Azariah<WH05838>, of Abednego<WH05664>.<CM>

But Daniel<WH01840> purposed<WH07760><WTH8799> in his heart<WH03820> that he would not defile<WH01351><WTH8691> himself with the portion<WH06598><WH00> of the king's<WH04428> meat<WH06598>, nor with the wine<WH03196> which he drank<WH04960>: therefore he requested<WH01245><WTH8762> of the prince<WH08269> of the eunuchs<WH05631> that he might not defile<WH01351><WTH8691> himself.
Now God<WH0430> had brought<WH05414><WTH8799> Daniel<WH01840> into favour<WH02617> and tender love<WH07356> with<WH06440> the prince<WH08269> of the eunuchs<WH05631>.

And the prince<WH08269> of the eunuchs<WH05631> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto Daniel<WH01840>, I fear<WH03373> my lord<WH0113> the king<WH04428>, who hath appointed<WH04487><WTH8765> your meat<WH03978> and your drink<WH04960>: for why should he see<WH07200><WTH8799> your faces<WH06440> worse liking<WH02196><WTH8802> than the children<WH03206> which <FI>are<Fi> of your sort<WH01524>? then shall ye make <FI>me<Fi>  endanger<WH02325><WTH8765> my head<WH07218> to the king<WH04428>. <RF>worse...: Heb. sadder<Rf> <RF>sort: or, term, or, continuance?<Rf>
